limitations: The two workbooks describe separate E7.5 and E6.5 mouse embryo cohorts. They are not longitudinally joined to one another.
Culture-efficiency denominators vary by sampled day and experiment continuation. They are not survival probabilities or verified all-start success rates.
The source labels normal development; the morphology classification does not establish sustained survival, organ function, complete gestation, live birth, or postnatal health.

Experiment-level fraction and percentage cells are preserved in a crosswalk. Two E6.5 percentage literals disagree with their own numerator/denominator pairs; aggregate counts reconcile, but the local source inconsistencies remain unresolved.
No human embryo evidence, clinical readiness, physiological operating specification, or complete human ectogenesis capability is established.
